description: Awin fall-back conversion image and S2S reads on www.awin1.com/sread.img and /sread.php.

params.name: merchant
params.description: It is the numeric Awin advertiser ID. The published pixel template requires it.
params.fix_hint: Set `merchant` to the Advertiser ID from the Awin UI.

params.name: tt
params.description: It is the tracking type. The image pixel sends `ns`; server-to-server sends `ss`.
params.fix_hint: Use `tt=ns` on the image pixel and `tt=ss` on the S2S read.

params.name: tv
params.description: It is the tracking version. The published template sends `tv=2`.

params.name: amount
params.description: It is the sale subtotal after discounts, excluding tax and shipping. Awin documents it as a float with a dot decimal.
params.fix_hint: Set `amount` to the order subtotal, with a dot decimal and no thousands separator.

params.name: ch
params.description: It names the last-click channel. Awin documents `aw` for Awin traffic.
params.fix_hint: Set `ch=aw` for Awin last-click, or the documented channel for that conversion.

params.name: parts
params.description: It is the commission group code plus amount, such as `DEFAULT:8.33`. Awin documents it as required.
params.fix_hint: Set `parts` to `{group}:{amount}`, using `DEFAULT` when no group is configured.

params.name: ref
params.description: It is the unique order reference. Awin documents it as required and unique per conversion.
params.fix_hint: Set `ref` to a unique, URL-encoded order identifier.

params.name: cr
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency code. The published template includes it.
params.fix_hint: Set `cr` to a three-letter currency code such as `GBP`.

params.name: testmode
params.description: Awin documents `0` for live conversions and `1` to skip processing.

params.name: vc
params.description: It is the voucher code when a discount was used.

params.name: cks
params.description: It is the Awin click identifier (`awc`) on server-to-server reads.
